verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰ ਗਹਤ ਸਰਪ ਸੁਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਫੁਸਲਾਇ ਉਰ ਮੰਡ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kar gahat sarap sut pekh maataa kahai na pukaar fusalai ur ma(n)dd hai ||

en.bdb: Just as seeing a snake in the hands of her son, the mother does not shout but very calmly endears him to herself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਦ ਰੋਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਔਖਦ ਖਵਾਇ ਰੋਗ ਡੰਡ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise baidh rogee prat kahai na bisathaar birathaa sa(n)jam kai aauakhadh khavai rog dda(n)dd hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a physician does not disclose the details of ailment to the patient but serves him medicine within strict preventions and makes him well.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਚਟੀਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਸੀਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਖੰਡ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bhool chook chaTeeaa kee na beechaarai paadhaa keh keh seekhiaa moorakhat mat kha(n)dd hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the teacher does not take the mistake of his student to heart, and instead he removes his ignorance by imparting him with necessary lesson.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਅਉਗਨ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਮਝਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise pekh aaugan kahai na satigur kaahoo pooran bibek samajhaavat pracha(n)dd hai ||356||

en.bdb: Similarly, the True Guru says nothing to a vice-infested disciple. Instead, he is blessed with complete knowledge. He makes him understand and changes him into a sharp-minded wise person. (356)
